summary.headline: ArisInfra Q1 FY27 revenue rose 37% YoY to INR 291 crore, EBITDA up 68% to INR 31 crore, margin 10.49%, PAT INR 20 crore.
summary.overview: Revenue from operations was INR 291 crore, up 37% YoY, with EBITDA of INR 31 crore (up 68% YoY) and margin of 10.49%, up 191 bps. PAT was INR 20 crore versus INR 5 crore a year earlier. Management attributed margin expansion to a mix shift toward contract manufacturing and DaaS, whose combined share rose from about 46% to 63%. Net working capital days fell to 56 from 66 at March 2026 (about 97 in the prior quarter per an analyst exchange), and management reiterated 35-40% annual growth guidance.

segments.name: B2B supply
segments.commentary: Entry point to the network; contributed about 37% of Q1 FY27 revenue. Covers almost all construction materials.

segments.name: Contract manufacturing
segments.commentary: Revenue grew 84% YoY and contributed about 53% of Q1 FY27 revenue. Covers stone aggregates, ready-mix concrete and asphalt; about 8.65 lakh MT delivered in the quarter.

segments.name: DaaS (Developer as a Service)
segments.commentary: Contributed about INR 28 crore, roughly 10% of top line, in Q1. New INR 650 crore mandate from Wadhwa Group (Mumbai); GDV under execution rose to over INR 1,800 crore from INR 1,250 crore at Q4 FY26. Management cited 60-65% EBITDA margin for DaaS.

segments.name: Asphalt (within contract manufacturing)
segments.commentary: Revenue rose to INR 53 crore from INR 30 crore in Q4 FY26; customers transacted rose to 38 from 28.
